inputs: same expanded six features and original selected bouts; no component score, cohort, clinical metadata or review flags in RF/DS inputs
splits: reuse exact existing outer 5 person folds and inner 3 person folds; every visit of a person stays together
draws: train draw0; evaluate draw0/1/2 separately, never average draws or seed predictions
baselines: outer-train person-weighted marginal medians; gait-score conditional medians for balance/chair and separately their sum; no random initialization, identical baseline predictions aligned to each seed and condition
missing: keep all visits; ignore only the unavailable supervised component in its loss/metric; never infer missing labels from total. Lookup predictions unavailable at 5 visits with missing observed gait score; matched comparisons explicitly restrict to available labels

DS.architecture: same six-input mean-pool encoder and hidden width as factorial B; three linear outputs instead of one
DS.width: reuse per-fold/seed/condition internally selected original width
DS.loss: mean of 3 person-weighted SmoothL1 beta .5 component losses; each observed component gets equal-person training weights and training-only standardization
DS.selection: minimum total-score inner person MAE of summed component predictions; earlier epoch breaks ties

RF.input: per-feature median of the same k bouts, six values
RF.selection: each component separately minimizes its inner person MAE; an additional direct-total RF uses the same grid and input

primary_predictions: raw continuous regression, no clipping or rounding, consistent with original experiments; bounded predictions are a separately marked sensitivity analysis
references: existing factorial A four-feature and B six-feature direct-total Deep Sets; B is the input-matched main comparator
metrics: equal-person MAE, bias, RMSE, weighted visit absolute-error P90; reweight within each target/subgroup
within_gait: report each observed gait score 0..4 separately for balance, chair and remaining sum; compare rich-input models against gait-only lookup on the same eligible rows
low_sppb: actual total<=3, unchanged from prior experiments; success requires overall MAE nonincrease plus lower tail MAE, separately tail P90 and all5-seed stability
uncertainty: paired person bootstrap of five-seed mean errors, conditional on fixed OOF fits; reused exploratory evaluation folds, not independent final validation
